title: LeadAnalysis
description: Structured facts and contextual insights extracted from unstructured lead message by AI.

industry.description: Detected industry vertical of the lead (e.g., 'restaurant', 'healthcare', 'ecommerce', 'manufacturing').

service_requested.description: Specific capability or service the prospect is asking for (e.g., 'LINE AI customer service', 'CRM automation', 'custom integration').

service_match.description: Which offering from the business profile's service catalog this lead maps to.

offering.description: Exact name of the matching catalog service, or null when nothing in the catalog fits.

tier.description: Tier of the matched catalog service; 'none' when no catalog service matches.

problem.description: Core business problem or operational bottleneck described by the prospect.

contact_role.description: Job title or role of the person writing, if stated (e.g., 'owner', 'operations manager').

budget.description: Explicit or stated budget range extracted from the message.

amount.description: Numeric budget amount if explicitly mentioned.

stated.description: True if budget was explicitly stated, false if absent or ambiguous.

timeline_days.description: Estimated implementation timeline requested in days (e.g., within 30 days = 30, urgent/asap = 7, null if unspecified).

intent.description: Stated commercial readiness level inferred strictly from message semantics.

language.description: Primary language of the enquiry message (e.g., 'th', 'en').

summary.description: Concise, factual 1-2 sentence executive summary of the lead enquiry.

missing_information.description: Key business qualification attributes not provided in the enquiry.

confidence_score.description: AI model self-assessed extraction confidence based on text clarity and completeness.
